analysis.purpose: Builds the AI-artifact graph: discovers the skills, agents, commands, rules and MCP configs that ordinary discovery misses, and links them to the code and each other.
responsibilities: Find tracked AI artifacts living under tool directories the walk skips
Emit one artifact node per discovered artifact
Resolve governs, requires and invokes edges between them

businessRules.rule: These artifacts are found deliberately because they live under gitignored tool directories the normal discovery walk never reaches.
businessRules.rationale: They shape agent behaviour, so leaving them out would hide the rules the agent is actually following.

nodes.name: AI artifact graph
nodes.summary: Skills, agents and rules as first-class graph nodes.

edges.rationale: This file builds the artifact graph.
